title: Hand It to Jesus
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Isaiah saw Him long ago,
A Man who knew the sad;
He was not scared of heavy hearts,
He took the sad we had.

[Chorus]
He gathered up the heavy load
In His own gentle hands;
And when my heart is heavy too,
I know He understands.

[Verse 2]
We all are like the little sheep
Who wander off and roam;
But Jesus came to find each one
And carry us back home.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
When Willow's brother dropped his cone
And cried and cried and cried,
She sat down close and held his hand
And stayed right by his side.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
And when your heart feels heavy, friend,
Don't hide your sad away;
Just hand it up to Jesus' arms,
He holds you close today.

[Chorus]
mood: Holding music. A slow, even sway under the voice, the rock of a child held on a lap until the crying slows, never hurried. Fingerpicked nylon guitar keeping the sway, the low bass string let ring under each chord like a hand resting on a back. Tender rather than sad, and a shade brighter with every verse, until the last chorus feels like a child set back on their feet and smiling.
